module: Flowgraph node "Flash Message" (category repeat_instant, duration): displays a message in the center of the screen via scenario/scenariohelper.flashUiMessage. Inputs: flow, "message" (any), "duration" (3 s), "instant" (hidden, clears previous ones), "biggerText" (hidden, true). Output: flow. Requires a UI layout that contains the messages app.
notes: Tables are passed as is, everything else is converted with tostring.
work() returns the message on every frame where the flow is active.

work.desc: If 'instant', sends 'ScenarioFlashMessageClear', then displays the message and copies the input flow to the output.
